name: EPIC 211912988
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 10.5 solar radii and 0.86 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,655 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 0.86 solar masses and 10.5 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,885 K at its surface.
